stories.title: Le gouvernement vaudois dévoile ses mesures pour absorber l’initiative 12% sur la pointe des pieds, et irrite des élus

en.title: Vaud government unveils measures to absorb the 12% initiative cautiously, angering elected officials
en.summary: The Vaud cantonal government proposed 100 million francs in savings and additional reserve mobilization to offset 272 million francs in fiscal losses from the 12% initiative approved by voters. The government preserves salaries while reducing funding to municipalities before elections in five months.

stories.title: Abkühlung und Regen in Sicht – Kommt jetzt endlich der Herbst – und bleibt er auch?

en.title: Cooling and rain in sight – is autumn finally coming – and will it stay?
en.summary: A cold front is expected to reach Switzerland starting tomorrow, bringing rain. A meteorologist discusses how long this weather system will persist.

stories.title: DER ANDERE BLICK - Die Lehre vom Müllcontainer aus dem Kibbuz Reim: Wer Israel helfen will, muss seine Sicherheitsinteressen wahren

en.title: The Other Perspective - The lesson from the trash container in Kibbutz Reim: Whoever wants to help Israel must respect its security interests
en.summary: The October 7 terrorist attack fundamentally transformed Israeli society, significantly reducing willingness to accept security risks. Israel's international partners must adjust their policies to reflect this new security-focused reality.

stories.title: Kulturnews in Kurzform – «67» ist nicht dabei: Die Top 3 Jugendwörter des Jahres

en.title: Culture news in brief – "67" is not included: The top 3 youth words of the year
en.summary: Three German words were selected as the top youth words for 2026: "Peak," "crashout," and "Ragebait" made it to the final rankings.

stories.title: Vaud distribue 24 millions en subventions sans pouvoir mesurer leur efficacité, dénonce la Cour des comptes

en.title: Vaud distributes 24 million in subsidies without ability to measure their effectiveness, audit office warns
en.summary: Switzerland's Vaud canton audit office criticizes how economic development subsidies are managed, citing poor oversight and funding of already-funded projects. Officials must reform the subsidy allocation system.

stories.title: Nobelpreis 2026 – Der Nobelpreis für Chemie geht an Henri B. Kagan und Kenso Soai

en.title: Nobel Prize 2026 – Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenzo Soai
en.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenzo Soai received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.title: Die Ski-WM 2027 in Crans-Montana kommen nicht zur Ruhe – nun tritt der OK-Präsident zurück

en.title: The 2027 Ski World Championships in Crans-Montana remain turbulent – now the organizing committee president resigns
en.summary: The organizing committee president of the 2027 Ski World Championships has resigned following criminal charges against him. The championship has faced ongoing organizational difficulties since its inception.

stories.title: Où en sont les enquêtes internationales trois ans après le 7-Octobre et la guerre à Gaza?

en.title: Where do international investigations stand three years after October 7 and the war in Gaza?
en.summary: International courts are pursuing Hamas and Israel for war crimes and crimes against humanity following the October 7, 2023 attack and resulting Gaza war. Legal proceedings have progressed slowly or stalled due to deaths of accused persons and political pressure.

stories.title: Wegen laufendem Strafverfahren – OK-Präsident der Ski-WM tritt zurück

en.title: Due to ongoing criminal proceedings – organizing committee president of Ski World Championships resigns
en.summary: Claude-Alain Schmidhalter steps down from his roles as president of the Ski World Championships organizing committee and vice-president of Swiss-Ski due to ongoing criminal proceedings against him.

stories.title: 7-Octobre, trois ans après: malgré la douleur, le message de paix d’Aviva et Keith Siegel, deux anciens otages du Hamas

en.title: October 7, three years later: despite the pain, a message of peace from Aviva and Keith Siegel, two former Hamas hostages
en.summary: Aviva and Keith Siegel, among 251 Israelis captured by Hamas on October 7, 2023, are survivors who have publicly testified about their ordeal. The couple continues to oppose the war despite Prime Minister Netanyahu citing hostage releases in his electoral campaign.

stories.title: Le Nobel de chimie prime Henri Kagan et Kenso Soai pour l'étude des molécules 'image miroir'

en.title: Chemistry Nobel Prize awarded to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for the study of 'mirror image' molecules
en.summary: A French and Japanese scientist received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on mirror-image molecules. Certain chemical reactions create two different molecules that are mirror images of one another.

stories.title: Ski alpin - Claude-Alain Schmidhalter est suspendu du comité des Mondiaux 2027 de Crans-Montana et démissionne

en.title: Alpine skiing - Claude-Alain Schmidhalter suspended from 2027 Crans-Montana Worlds committee and resigns
en.summary: Claude-Alain Schmidhalter has resigned from his positions as president of the organizing committee for the 2027 alpine skiing world championships in Crans-Montana and vice-president of Swiss-Ski following his suspension from both roles.

stories.title: «Putsch gegen die direkte Demokratie»: Das Parlament will kantonale Mindestlöhne übersteuern, nun lancieren die Gewerkschaften den Abstimmungskampf

en.title: "Coup against direct democracy": Parliament wants to override cantonal minimum wages, unions now launch referendum campaign
en.summary: Swiss unions have launched a referendum campaign against Parliament's proposed override of cantonal minimum wage laws. Supporters of minimum wages argue they strengthen purchasing power, while opponents contend they weaken Switzerland's successful social partnership model.

stories.title: Porsche soll sich gesundschrumpfen – und noch stärker zur Lieblingsmarke der Elite werden

en.title: Porsche to slim down and become even more the luxury brand of the elite
en.summary: New Porsche CEO Michael Leiters presented a strategy focusing on traditional combustion engine vehicles and higher pricing. The company aims to strengthen its position as an elite luxury brand rather than pursue broader market expansion.

stories.title: Bei Lindt & Sprüngli sind die Aktionäre unzufrieden – aber die Allmacht von Ernst Tanner können sie nicht brechen

en.title: Lindt & Sprüngli shareholders are dissatisfied – but they cannot break Ernst Tanner's control
en.summary: The chocolate company has lost significant market value, reducing founder Ernst Tanner's wealth by 165 million francs. The 80-year-old nevertheless maintains complete control over the company.

stories.title: Wenn sich die Ukraine und Südkorea streiten, freut sich Russland

en.title: When Ukraine and South Korea quarrel, Russia benefits
en.summary: Diesel deliveries to Russia are raising questions about South Korea's support for Ukraine, while disputes over North Korean prisoners of war threaten to further damage relations between the two partners.

stories.title: Machtkampf an den Finanzmärkten: Die steigenden Anleiherenditen könnten die Aktienkurse bald in die Knie zwingen

en.title: Power struggle in financial markets: Rising bond yields could soon force stock prices to their knees
en.summary: Bond and stock markets sometimes appear contradictory, raising questions about what investors can learn from historical patterns when these asset classes diverge.
